maddeler.e:
يتساهم (form VI)
# يَتَسَاهَمُ (yatasāhamu) /ja.ta.saː.ha.mu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of تَسَاهَمَ (tasāhama)
# يَتَسَاهَمَ (yatasāhama) /ja.ta.saː.ha.ma/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of تَسَاهَمَ (tasāhama)
# يَتَسَاهَمْ (yatasāham) /ja.ta.saː.ham/: third-person masculine singular non-past active jussive of تَسَاهَمَ (tasāhama)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
